notes.title: 🎵 Mercyful Flames: The Witches OST out now 🎵 - the dungeon synth soundtrack will support an organisation dedicated to reducing animal suffering 🐣
notes.content:
The album, titled “Spells”, is the newest release from Alembik, the project by a member of Owls Woods Graves, Medico Peste, Over the Voids, Hauntologist, and live bassist of Mgła.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/3d41254d2429561820559ff8f71ce5476c152af8.jpg

Listen to the full OST here: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BMRgP67oHII 
Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/album/5uYLlYDCkCxzuNfK6AEpn2

Wishlist and Follow:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1066740/

In other news
- we just passed 3,000 followers on Steam! Thank you!
- we continue our charity efforts with Dagon
- ...and we're working on some cool stuff for Pool of Madness (32,000 wishlists and counting)

That's all for now, thanks for reading!

notes.title: 🔥 Lovecraftian Days Sale supporting charity and Pool of Madness playtest 🔥
notes.content:
Time to celebrate Lovecraftian Days 2025! All Dagon: by H. P. Lovecraft DLCs are now 20% off for the duration of the festival!

New playtest of Pool of Madness for Lovecraftian Days 2025

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/9e8556e2ab6b0af106a1163edd893e5b54c6c3e2.jpg

One year ago, we unveiled our new project - a Lovecraftian roguelite pool - during Lovecraftian Days. Today, as LD 2025 launches, we'd like to invite you to the latest playtest. Among other things, it
features an item viewing mechanics connected to the game's story.

Give it a try, even if you don't fancy yourself a pool player - it's a best of its own! Simply click on download the demo to play.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873750

Some of the features:

 a short introductory ritual for new players

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/1d457d9c20e955b0c5d1984ce84dd340b99f64bf.gif

 initial foundations for a boss fight (early WIP) and ritual progression mechanics

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/ff91914c3187bca531bfb4e8b58f5cedc444b0a3.gif

 item viewing mechanics and first interactive items (look around the room from time to time)

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/73972d031beb9f9f6cd9be3edfb3497f9b1065a5.gif

 many under-the-hood improvements and bugfixes

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/e0cab33a6a0909ecbe9469cc1ac1a9b5c7cacd20.gif


    
Thank you to Fulqrum Publishing for shining a light on our games and charity efforts!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/7feb4d3deb1217af33b336d5e951cac330b920c2.gif

As always, all feedback is welcome - leave us a comment on our Steam forums or
discord - it will help us improve the game!

notes.title: Pool of Madness limited demo is OUT - single-player and coop modes available! 🎱🐙
notes.content:
Occultists! We've just released a limited playtest of our roguelite combining pool and cosmic horror.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/ea0f1766128a20e4f1be075c1dde8c728a42e5df.png

It features single-player and coop modes, made especially for Steam Couch Co-op Fest!

TRY IT OUT
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/26037a494575f388a96043a6412d9ea4083cb5e0.gif

Get the demo here:

store.steampowered.com/app/2873750/pool_of_madness/ 


WHAT IS THIS ABOMINATION?

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/924b5ca139c5ed65912e8695e7961b0a11bfb9e9.gif

Think Inscryption meets Diablo/PoE meets a twisted game of pool. A unique experience with lots of mystery, emergent gameplay and endless replayability. That's the goal for the full version of the game.

While this is the first stab at a PoM multiplayer mode and we expect A LOT to change, we feel it's already fun and we could really use your feedback as we continue building Pool of Madness into our dream game.

This is definitely one of our favourite projects we've worked on and the most unique one, so it's great to see players already appreciating the core features!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/a1131695a7d969e2ef1cf980ff7007961275b329.png

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/4203c595a622626b1b201c3a4069a7ee58781e5c.png

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/2644810ec3c401f190d9943647c2f9ff1e91b826.png

PS It works great on Steam Deck!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/de65a69505abc5a9abe219e2e4f39d9f7f920e24.jpg


CHANGELOG

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/fa0e431f5cd37ee84389f571a716862e1f523381.gif

Changes from the previous limited playtest include:
- a hotseat coop mode featuring a new totem
- new powerups
- completely new UI (still WIP, similarly to other features)
- premium pockets (that will feature increasing modifiers later down the line)
- many bugfixes


WHAT'S NEXT?

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/a05115bb71d175ef512c1e26ba250ba5dca41963.gif

We're currently focusing on making the gameplay as much fun as possible, testing out different ideas and features, as well as working on the story in parallel. This is why these imperfect playtests are so important, as they allow us to gather feedback from players around the world while the game is still in development.

Things will be rough for a while in terms of the overall presentation, until we're satisfied with the gameplay part and implement & test various features, then we'll begin focusing more on the audiovisual side of things.

Thank you for taking the time to check out this crazy abomination our eldritch baby of a game! We think we have something really special here - we'd love you to help us shape it!

Want more forbidden knowledge? Check the Steam description!

notes.title: Pool of Madness - New limited-time demo with new graphics and physics!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/bf6c625f7a5e7d0d21e214583938cdbb747f1b98.png

Steam Endless Replayability Fest is here, and to celebrate, we're back with a NEW limited-time demo for Pool of Madness, our Lovecraftian roguelite... pool!

The demo is now LIVE on our Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873750

The first demo was a huge success, resulting in 11,000 wishlists and a very enthusiastic response from players, which was an awesome surprise, as it was a very early build of the game created within a month since the internal game jam that spawned PoM. We've used your feedback to introduce some updates to Early Demo #2 - find the list below!

Pool of Madness Endless Replayability Fest Demo - major updates:

 updated graphics, visibility & high resolution
 rewritten physics
 new feature: ability to freeze the ball (check Help), making the gameplay more dynamic and unique
 new phase, power bar, explosion & blood marks and other smaller changes!


Please note that Pool of Madness is very much a work in progress and we're working on improving every aspect of the game. We're sharing an updated demo so we can continue gathering feedback from players early and shape the game together. 

So... grab the demo and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Valentine's Day update 💖
notes.content:
Happy Valentine's Day fellow cosmic horror lovers! 

As a sign of our devotion to the one who haunts our dreams, we have just released an update for Dagon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312070/4e1c1fd3bdd841c1ed2e05bff9b417916193e184.jpg

This update contains:

 2 new languages: Ukrainian and Arabic
 reduced build size
 improved translations
 new Turkish font
 fixed problems with some of the Achievements
 fixed problems with the gamepad usage
 dozens of small fixes and improvements in scenes and UI


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361560


The Great Old One is all alone in the sunken R'lyeh... Let's show him that we think about him as much as he thinks about us on this special day!
